Demonstrate effective on-the-job communication and cultural competency skills in interactions with employers, co-workers and clients/customers.
Successfully engage in activities involving soft skills such as communication, teamwork, critical thinking, problem solving, and conflict resolution.
Read, interpret, explain and complete common workplace documents and forms.
